heading: Beta join in this edition
text:
### Beta join in this edition [LNLS.5.8]

[LNLS.5.1]'s bounds do not bind this edition. In a `linear_scan: false`
program the engine's joins cost this:

- A positive beta node indexes its left memory and its right alpha memory on
  one equality anchor, the first in its join-test list ([IRET.7.5.1]). A probe
  returns every entry that shares the anchor's value, and the node's other
  join tests decide among them. When the anchor is the whole of a schema's
  identity, a probe returns at most one entry. When the identity has several
  key slots and the anchor is one of them, it returns every entry sharing that
  slot's value.
- A negated (`no`) node holds no index: an activation of it tests every entry
  of the memory it joins against.
